description: Search EPA civil and criminal enforcement cases by state, ZIP code, regulatory program, case type, or filing-date range. Returns case identifier, programs involved, penalty assessed, settlement and filing dates, and case type. Designed for area-level violation discovery — for a single known facility's enforcement history use epa_get_facility instead. At least one of state or zip_code is required.

case_type.description: Filter by case type: civil (regulatory violations), criminal (willful violations), or all. A filing-date range covers civil cases only: with a date, all returns civil cases and criminal is rejected.

date_filed_end.description: Latest filing date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Civil cases only. Omit, or pass "", for no upper bound.

date_filed_start.description: Earliest filing date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Civil cases only. Omit, or pass "", for no lower bound.

limit.description: Maximum number of cases to return (1–100)

program.description: Filter by regulatory program: CAA=Clean Air Act, CWA=Clean Water Act, RCRA=hazardous waste, SDWA=drinking water, CERCLA=Superfund, FIFRA=pesticides, TSCA=toxic substances. Matches any law a case cites, so a returned case's programsViolated (its primary law) can differ.

state.description: 2-letter US state abbreviation to filter cases (e.g. "TX", "CA")

zip_code.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the case's facility location

name: epa_search_violations

items.description: EPA enforcement case record with case number, program, and penalty details

caseId.description: Case number / docket identifier (e.g. "03-2014-7010") — primary case reference

facilityName.description: Regulated facility name — not available in ECHO enforcement case records; use epa_get_facility with a Registry ID for facility details

filedDate.description: Date the enforcement case was filed (MM/DD/YYYY) — the date the filing-date range bounds

penaltyAssessedInDollars.description: Federal penalty assessed in dollars (parsed from ECHO dollar string)

registryId.description: EPA Registry ID — not returned in enforcement case search results; obtain via epa_search_facilities

state.description: State where the facility is located — not returned in enforcement case search results

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_geographic_filter`: Neither state nor zip_code was provided. `invalid_date`: date_filed_start or date_filed_end is not a real calendar date, such as 2024-02-30. `date_range_inverted`: date_filed_start is later than date_filed_end. `criminal_date_filter`: case_type "criminal" was combined with a filing-date bound, which ECHO records for civil cases only. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.
Recovery hint when no cases are found — echoes filters and suggests broadening. Absent when cases are returned.

notice.description: Present when a filing-date range with case_type "all" left criminal cases out of the results.

totalCount.description: Total cases matched before the limit was applied

title: Search EPA Enforcement Cases
